summary: Northern Dynasty Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the three months ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, containing standard financial statements, notes, and MD&A. There are no disclosed special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, or management changes. The filing is purely an earnings update with no transactional or corporate action elements.
